g.text: Zephyr sensors: acquisition APIs have different memory contracts
A · Fetch/Get: one synchronized owner across both calls
B · Read/Decode: explicit buffer lifetime, RTIO-capable path
Z3 · Fetch/Get and Read/Decode are alternative client models · driver and bus support still matter
Trigger callbacks run in a configured workqueue or driver thread, not user mode. A trigger is not a portable timestamp or a sample queue.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
